info.title: ChitraBodh Internal Pilot API
info.description: Proposed API contract, not current localhost implementation. API and database guides define cross-record checks. Target 60–90 seconds; accept 40–90. Cookie session plus CSRF for browser mutations. Email/password self-service registration is supported; no billing.
